title: Last Resort Soup
description: Adds an insanely OP stew that is meant as a last resort when all else fails
body:
**Last Resort Soup**

Last Resort Soup is a small endgame datapack that adds one **extremely powerful soup** meant for moments when everything has already gone wrong.

It adds a custom suspicious stew recipe that gives a stack of **strong effects for ten minutes**. The goal is simple stay alive when you normally would not. This is not meant to be balanced or used often. It is something you consume only when you are truly desperate.

The recipe is intentionally expensive using items like a totem of undying an enchanted golden apple ghast tear and diamond blocks. If you are willing to spend those resources the soup gives you a real second chance.

The soup has an enchantment glint so it stands out and feels special without adding extra mechanics or commands.

**the rightfull owner of this datapack is me, anyone else is a copy**
